title: Upgrade ALL Pipelines to Level 3+ Decision Quality
brief: Every decision evaluates ≥3 alternatives with physics scoring. No more hardcoded switch/case for critical decisions. ToolpathCostComparison shows strategy×tooling matrix.

units.title: Turning: selectInsert() → SCORED selection from KB
units.description: Replace switch/case with KB selectInsertGeometry(). Evaluate 5+ geometries (CNMG/DNMG/VNMG/WNMG/CCMT). Score by geometry fit, nose radius vs Ra, approach angle vs access, strength vs force, cost. Return top 3 with rationale.
exit_conditions: Turning: selectInsert() → SCORED selection from KB complete

units.title: Turning: calculateCuttingParams() → FULL Kienzle + manufacturer data
units.description: Add approach angle. Add nose radius engagement. Add thermal derating. Use KB getSpeed() + manufacturer S/F data instead of inline tables.
exit_conditions: Turning: calculateCuttingParams() → FULL Kienzle + manufacturer data complete

units.title: Milling: real geometry + pocket toolpath + cutter comp
units.description: Feature XYZ dims → real coordinates. Pocket offset clearing (zigzag simple, adaptive complex). G41/G42 for contour ops. Chip thinning correction.
exit_conditions: Milling: real geometry + pocket toolpath + cutter comp complete

units.title: 5-Axis: real multi-point toolpath + G93 + kinematics
units.description: Generate XYZ-AB point arrays via CutterContactEngine. G93 inverse time. Machine kinematic limits from MachineProfile. ToolAxisOptimizationEngine for orientation.
exit_conditions: 5-Axis: real multi-point toolpath + G93 + kinematics complete

units.title: Grinding: SCORED wheel selection from 11 specs
units.description: Evaluate ALL 11 wheel specs against target Ra, material, operation. Score and rank.
exit_conditions: Grinding: SCORED wheel selection from 11 specs complete

units.title: Laser: auto-select process mode (fiber vs CO2 × assist gas)
units.description: Score combinations using existing material DB (R_fiber, R_co2, recommended_gas).
exit_conditions: Laser: auto-select process mode (fiber vs CO2 × assist gas) complete

units.title: Waterjet: auto-select quality + pierce strategy
units.description: Score Q1-Q5 against target Ra + taper. Auto-select pierce from material brittleness.
exit_conditions: Waterjet: auto-select quality + pierce strategy complete

units.title: ALL: wire OptimalStrategySelection into every pipeline
units.description: Query E1087 for strategy with physics scoring. Not internal switch/case.
exit_conditions: ALL: wire OptimalStrategySelection into every pipeline complete

units.title: ALL: wire PipelineDecisionOrchestrator for audit trail
units.description: Every decision through E1080 for 5-axis scoring + safety veto + justification.
exit_conditions: ALL: wire PipelineDecisionOrchestrator for audit trail complete

units.title: Build ToolpathCostComparisonEngine
units.description: Generate 2+ options (simple vs advanced toolpath, crib vs catalog tools). Show cost comparison matrix. Batch economics.

units.title: ALL: wire collision avoidance per machine type
units.description: CollisionPreventionEngine with machine-specific zones (turret swing, spindle head, wire guide, nozzle, etc.).
exit_conditions: ALL: wire collision avoidance per machine type complete

units.title: ALL: add MC uncertainty (500 trials) to cutting pipelines
units.description: Milling, 5-Axis, Turning, Mill-Turn get CI95 on force/life/Ra matching grinding/EDM/laser/waterjet standard.
exit_conditions: ALL: add MC uncertainty (500 trials) to cutting pipelines complete
